tree_snapshot.target: 真人 Cosplay / 人像现场摄影；重点适配中国漫展、外景与场馆拍摄

method: Read USER_BRIEF.txt, RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md, SKILL_TREE.json, SOURCE_MAP.json, CONFLICTS.json and CLUSTER_DECISIONS.json.
Audited the tree against all A-I dimensions and mapped all ten supplied real problems to explicit current node paths.
Performed fresh web searches and opened accessible professional source text. Course pages, videos not watched, and inaccessible pages are treated as leads rather than detailed evidence.
Cross-checked the parent-created raw/cosplay_gap_candidates.json and raw/cosplay_gap_sources.json; those 16 focused searches count as parent research, not this independent audit's new searches.
No sample-image pixels were reviewed; no personal skill status or aesthetic acceptance was inferred.

dimension_audit.name: 拍摄流程
dimension_audit.status: strong foundation; important post-shoot reflection gap
dimension_audit.finding: 拍前、地点、规则、短时优先级、现场检查、筛片及反馈→下一次尝试均有节点。当前缺少有来源支撑的自我复盘方法：将原定角色/场景表达与成片比较，诊断自己造成差异的原因，再明确下一次验证。不能以泛节点 field-location-liveview-check 或 field-feedback-to-experiment 冒充这段能力。

dimension_audit.name: 技术
dimension_audit.status: broad core coverage; some venue-condition variants remain
dimension_audit.finding: 曝光、对焦、快门、景深、焦段/透视、闪光同步/冻结与色彩均有明确训练项；未见大块基础技术空白。中国场馆 LED 频闪/电子快门兼容、自动追焦和混合灯肤色需按实际设备/场馆条件定向补源，属于重要条件变体。

dimension_audit.name: 视觉
dimension_audit.finding: 边缘、背景密度、留白/位置、层次、主体分离、线条、图形、视觉重量与平衡均覆盖；保留居中/偏置、平衡/表达性失衡等条件性冲突。没有声称对树中作品做过视觉验收。

dimension_audit.name: 人物
dimension_audit.status: broad portrait/cosplay foundation; lower-body and costume-specific limits
dimension_audit.finding: 承重、躯干角度、手臂分离、头/眼神、表情、角色意图、无接触指导及动作流覆盖。足/腿/关节的细分姿态力学与具体宽袖/长裙动作边界未达到相同粒度；现有节点不宜宣称覆盖每类服装限制。

dimension_audit.name: Cosplay 特殊能力
dimension_audit.status: general foundation exists; short-dagger/wide-sleeve/wig constraints are bounded gaps
dimension_audit.finding: 服装可见度、协作布料动态、大型道具、日本刀角色姿势、一般非武器小道具及角色表现有基础。新小道具节点的明确边界是非武器及脸部轮廓遮挡；不能延伸成匕首刃尖方向/腕部/身体关系。未找到宽袖专门手势与袖口剪影、假发静态整理/风致控制的充分直接材料。

dimension_audit.name: 场景
dimension_audit.status: broad locations; crowded China convention method is a serious target-context gap
dimension_audit.finding: 外景、窗光、建筑、阴影、逆光、夜景及规则核对有一般基础。复杂漫展背景可做减法，但缺少中国高密度场馆里如何选取可拍位置、避开人流/他人入镜、快速重构背景并轮转拍摄的直接完整方法。场馆政策节点不等于场馆摄影技术。

dimension_audit.name: 执行
dimension_audit.status: partial-to-strong; integrated rapid-floor operation and self-review gaps
dimension_audit.finding: 短时优先级、方向口令、舒适度、现场检查、寻求反馈及下一轮尝试均有节点。缺少在拥挤/嘈杂/短时、道具与场馆约束下整合成一条经过来源支持的快速执行流程；拍后个人原因诊断也未被独立建立。

dimension_audit.name: 后期
dimension_audit.status: broad workflow and technical foundations; cosplay-specific retouch constraints remain
dimension_audit.finding: 筛片、组照多样性/连贯、颜色与局部光影、背景清理、合成匹配及按用途交付都有模块。新加入的用途边界来自 PPA 官方规则。Cosplay 假发/盔甲/仿制武器材质的保真修饰和授权语境仍未被专门覆盖，但不是整个后期流程空白。

dimension_audit.name: 动态
dimension_audit.status: broad foundations; practical target transfer is bounded
dimension_audit.finding: 动作冻结/模糊/追随、时机预判、动作组照变化、视频起点/路径/终点、景别覆盖、预演及手动拉焦均有节点。部分来自电影教材或设备教育适配，不能直接等同于漫展现场的安全、空间与服装交互实战方法。

reflection_loop_audit.verdict: partial; enough to establish critique-to-next-attempt, insufficient for a full self-diagnosis loop

covered_now.support: The tree asks the photographer to seek specific professional feedback on photographs.

Current wording is appropriately narrow: use photo-specific feedback to name an adjustment/technique to try next time and record the link. Derryberry directly supports using constructive critique to shoot again/try new techniques; Harris supports practicing a new technique and testing/adjusting in real assignments. The one-variable procedure is expressly project-designed, not attributed to either source.
Supports revisiting/selecting work in passes, but not causal self-diagnosis.
Supports selected in-field checks; these are not a post-shoot review of story/character intent.

reflection_loop_audit.still_missing: A sourced and atomic capability to review an intended expression/story against the delivered frames, identify whether the mismatch arose from direction, pose, framing, light, timing, setting or post, and choose an evidence-based next check. No generic node should be counted as coverage for this full chain.
reflection_loop_audit.severity: important/core-loop gap for the user's explicit target; not evidence that technical photography domains are broadly empty
reflection_loop_audit.recommendation: Keep field-location-reflection excluded as a formal professional skill until exact direct evidence is found. A project review worksheet may be designed separately with fields for intent, observed result, supported diagnosis/uncertainty and next attempt, explicitly labeled project-designed. Do not call it professional consensus or a sourced L3.

pathreverseaudit.status: mapped as conditional photographer-method skill; conflict retained

pathreverseaudit.covers: Intentionally control roll and judge whether it serves the composition.
pathreverseaudit.residual: Sources differ on useful angle magnitude (Elja Trum's larger stylized tilt vs Nikon's much smaller limits); do not average to one normative angle.

pathreverseaudit.covers: Test whether crop near a joint reads as accidental in a given frame.
pathreverseaudit.residual: Not a blanket rule against knee crops; no universal crop threshold.

composition > composition-1 边缘与裁切 > composition-edge-sweep
field > field-2 地点与环境叙事 > field-background-first / field-background-priority
pathreverseaudit.covers: Reduce distractions, manage information density, sweep frame edges and prioritize background selection.
pathreverseaudit.residual: Dense con-floor practice is still a target context gap; generic background reduction is not the same as a crowd floor method.

core_gaps.gap: Complete post-shoot self-review chain: stated intended character/story → what the delivered frames actually communicate → evidence-based diagnosis of the photographer-controlled cause or explicit uncertainty → next verification. Existing nodes cover critique seeking and trying a next change, but not this self-diagnosis bridge.
core_gaps.action: Search for primary, first-person portrait/Cosplay professional practice that explicitly describes reviewing own shoot results against intent and choosing next actions. Until then keep as an explicit gap; a project worksheet may be labeled project-designed.

core_gaps.gap: A usable method for fast portrait-making on a dense Chinese convention floor: choose a workable background/position, avoid blocking traffic and including others, share/rotate a location and preserve time for each subject.
core_gaps.action: Sources are bounded leads only. Continue targeted Chinese/Japanese convention-floor field reports or professional event photographer first-person guidance; do not formalize the candidate from a rule page or a staged backdrop setup.

qualitative_95_point_review.verdict: Not yet defensible as a 95-point-complete target tree; suitable as a substantial interim atlas under active audit.
qualitative_95_point_review.reasons: Core composition, perspective, posing, lighting, exposure, dynamic, field planning and post-workflow are populated with real trainable nodes. However, the user's explicit failure-learning loop lacks direct support for self-review and photographer-controlled cause diagnosis; the target venue context (dense Chinese convention floor) lacks an integrated sourced method; and short-dagger/wide-sleeve variants remain clear known gaps. These limitations affect relevant tasks without making all of their parent domains empty.
not_claimed: No owner-photo or aesthetic acceptance was tested.
Node count does not demonstrate complete target coverage.
Project-designed exercises are not professional consensus.
next_loop_priority: Search for a first-party portrait/Cosplay self-review example explicitly linking intent, observed output, cause and next test.
Continue direct Chinese/Japanese professional field research for dense convention floor operation.
Only promote dagger/wide-sleeve/wig variants when a source supports their actual controllable variable.
